lines.text: Penso che un [sogno] così non ritorni mai più
lines.english: I think that such a dream will never return again
lines.note: che + congiuntivo: Verbs of opinion like 'penso che' trigger the subjunctive ('ritorni').

lines.text: Mi dipingevo le [mani] e la faccia di blu
lines.english: I painted my hands and my face in blue
lines.note: le mani: Irregular feminine plural ending in -i (singular: la mano).

lines.english: Then suddenly I was snatched away by the wind
lines.note: imperfetto passivo: 'venivo rapito' means 'I was being carried away'.

lines.text: E incominciavo a volare nel cielo infinito
lines.english: And I began to fly in the infinite sky
To sing, oh, oh, oh, oh

lines.note: invariable adjective: 'blu' keeps the same form regardless of gender or number.
